steps.say: Your firm's client register in {product}: every assessee once, carried into each assessment year - and each year's stage moves by itself.
Every client of your firm, once. Other firms' clients never show here.
The quickest way in: pick who the return is for right here - a person, an HUF, a firm, an LLP or an AOP - and New filing lists the documents, reads them and makes the client.

New here? Start here lists your first steps in {product}, each with a button to its screen. A step ticks itself once it is really done. Hide puts the card away; your name menu, top right, brings it back.

Prefer the menu across the top? Your name menu, top right, has Menu: Side pane or Top menu. Every screen follows your pick, and a group in the top menu shows its new items as a red count. On a phone both are the Menu button.
How many clients are in this year, how many are audited, and the pipeline by stage.
Switch the assessment year; each row shows its form, the 3CD tag and its stage.
Nobody picks the stage: statements in, every row mapped, 26AS in and the reds explained, signed off, filed. Each row's dots show where it is.
Name, status, PAN, GSTIN, banks - plus date of birth, non-resident, and the signatory's father's name and PAN for the ITR. The PAN's fourth letter must fit the status.

Status Company - the PAN's fourth letter C - opens its own box: CIN, date of incorporation, kind and tax option (normal, 115BA, 115BAA or 115BAB), the directors who sign and the shareholders of 1% or more. ITR-6's Part A-GEN and Schedule SH come from here.

Each client keeps its parties - lenders, payees and relatives - with name, address and PAN. Fill from statements reads them off this year's 3CD rows; type a missing PAN once and Form 3CD clauses 31 and 23 carry it every year.
Tick the clients you no longer serve - or Select all on this page - and Archive selected. Each moves to the Archived tab with every filing of theirs; nothing is deleted.
To put away just one year's filing, open the client and press Archive this filing - the client stays active with every other year.
On the Archived tab, tick and Restore selected: a client comes back with the filings archived with it; a filing archived on its own comes back by itself.
